denominator.summary: Men 21-75 and women 40-75 with ASCVD (MI, IHD, revascularization status, ischemic stroke, PAD) in the measurement or prior year; enrolled. Agere applies 21-75 to both sexes and drops women under 40 via the sex-specific criterion.

criteria.label: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (MI, IHD, revascularization, ischemic stroke, PAD)

exclusions.label: Hospice or palliative care (Z51.5 / hospice encounter)
End-stage renal disease or dialysis (N18.6, Z99.2)
Myalgia, myositis, myopathy or rhabdomyolysis (M60.8, M60.9, M62.82, M79.1, G72.0, G72.9)

numerator.summary: At least one statin (any intensity) dispensed in the period.

gap_label: ASCVD: no statin dispensed this period
notes: HEDIS SPC numerator requires moderate- or high-intensity statins; dose is not reliably received, so any statin counts.
Women under 40 are not removed (sex-specific age floors are not expressible in one age band); the effect is small.
